translations.text: Then the Pharisees and the scribes of the Jewish people murmured, because the Saviour received sinners and ate with them.
Then the Saviour told this parable to the Jewish scribes: "Which of you has a hundred sheep," and so on.
Then the heavenly physician, with a gentle parable, wished kindly to heal the swelling of their hearts, and spoke thus: "Which of you has a hundred sheep,
When he found it, he carried it on his shoulders to the flock, rejoicing.
He said, "I tell you, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinful man, if he repents of his sins with penance, than over ninety-nine righteous who need no repentance."
Just as the farmer loves the field that yields abundant crops after thorns and brambles more than he loves the one that was never thorny and does not bear fruit.
Yet there are very many righteous people who are innocent of capital sins, and who nevertheless keep as strict a way of life as if they were burdened with every sin.
No penitent can be compared to them, because they are both righteous and repentant.

Mankind was created to make up the tenth host, because the tenth host became guilty through pride, and they were all turned into accursed devils and thrust from the heavenly bliss into the torments of hell.
Seraphim means "burning" or "kindling": they burn the more strongly in God's love the more closely they are joined to him;
The saints who work miracles in this life are ranked among the heavenly Virtues, who perform God's signs.
Some are so excellent that by their lordship they rule over all vices and sins in themselves, so that they are counted as gods because of that lofty purity:
of such the Almighty said to Moses, "I have appointed you to be Pharaoh's god."
True love is the fulfilment of God's law, and whoever keeps the love of God and of other people in his conduct is then rightly called cherubim;
Some of God's servants are kindled with such great desire to be near their Creator that they despise all worldly cares,
But the soul that lacks these virtues should lament and long for the bountiful Ruler to join it, through his grace, to the lot of his chosen ones.
Not everyone receives the same gifts from God, because he grants spiritual honours to each according to his diligence.
Each host has certain gifts of its own from its Creator, yet their dignity is shared by them all, and what any one host has in part, it has fully in another host;
Cherubim means "fullness of knowledge" or "of understanding", and yet what angel in God's presence does not know all things?
Truly, the person who repents of his error is the one who does not repeat his former deeds;
of this the Saviour said to the bedridden man he had healed, "Behold, now you are healed; sin no more from now on, lest something worse happen to you."

Believers may have great trust and hope in Christ, the God who became man, who is our Protector and Judge, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, for ever and ever. Amen.
